A separate 1-year free Micro Server exists but the page states ' , ' (offered only if the country of residence is Korea).

chaining: A KRW 100,000 credit over 3 months buys roughly a small Standard server for part of that window, and the 1-year Micro Server that would make it a real host is closed to non-residents, so the credit is a sandbox rather than a host.

limits.value: The credit is granted only after a payment method is registered and the account is real-name verified by mobile phone, and the perpetually free Micro Server is limited to residents of Korea, so the free lane that survives is a 3-month KRW 100,000 credit behind a card.

notes: This corrects the corpus. dossier/compute/naver-cloud.json records Naver as 'no free tier ... paid-only', sourced from the product page, which does not carry the credit event. The credit is live on the separate event page. The correction is not a promotion: the verdict moves from paid-only to trial-only, which tells a reader to look and find a card-gated 3-month window instead of skipping the provider. Two live pages disagree on the size (KRW 100,000 vs 'up to KRW 300,000'), and neither explains the gap; the 300,000 figure appeared in a 2022 blog post as a 200,000+100,000 stack, so the 300,000 is probably an older promotion left up. Corrected 2026-10-22: the KRW 200,000 Green Rookie credit and the exam voucher are for students and staff of a participating institution, which is an institution gate rather than a trial any account can start.
